Actual Weight and Volumetric Weight

Actual weight includes goods and packaging. Some routes charge using whichever is greater: actual weight or volumetric weight. The official help formula is length × width × height in centimetres, divided by the route’s divisor. It lists 5000, 6000, 7000 or 8000 depending on the logistics provider. Use the selected route’s own rule rather than one universal divisor.

The official charging article states that USFans does not charge a purchasing service fee for orders from regular shopping platforms. Buyers still pay for the goods and shipping, and can choose value-added services. This statement applies to the described purchasing service; it does not mean every payment or warehouse option is free.

The official guide directs users to click Tracking Details on the parcel they want to follow. Use your parcel record after international dispatch; a seller’s domestic delivery to the warehouse is a different stage. Match the parcel ID and tracking number to the shipment you are checking.

The official guide separates product price plus domestic shipping, international shipping and customs charges. Record each component before ordering. International shipping depends on parcel weight, method and destination. This catalog displays a reference item price in USD; it excludes the other components and can differ from the live quote.

The official help articles explain that international transport includes multiple transfers and updates can lag. They give examples of a first update around three days after dispatch on some routes and later scans taking three to ten days on some routes. These are examples, not universal delivery promises. Check your selected route’s current guidance.

The official policy counts from the date the order status shows Warehoused. Use the recorded date for each item, rather than the day you registered, paid the seller or first visited this catalog. Items arriving on different dates can have different deadlines even if you plan to ship them together.

The official policy states that goods can be deemed abandoned and destroyed if no shipment order is submitted or no feedback is received within the time limit. Check the current storage policy and your warehouse notifications before leaving an item stored. A saved find on this site neither starts nor extends warehouse storage.

The official storage article reviewed on 9 October 2026 lists 90 days for purchasing-agent parcels and 60 days for forwarding parcels. These are different services; identify how your item entered the warehouse before applying a period. The article states a storage period, so this guide does not label the entire period as free storage.
